LESSON: FOOD AND FITNESS NUTRITION

Grade: Grade 3
Subject: HYGIENE AND NUTRITION ACTIVITIES
Strand: Foods and
Topic 3.3: Food and fitness Nutrition

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! Today we learn about Food and fitness Nutrition. Read the explanation, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

Big question: Why do we eat food?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. Explain the main ideas in Food and fitness Nutrition
2. Practise Food and fitness Nutrition at school and at home
3. Give Kenyan examples connected to Food and fitness Nutrition

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. Explain the main ideas in Food and fitness Nutrition
   In simple words: practise until you can explain the main ideas in Food and fitness Nutrition. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

2. Practise Food and fitness Nutrition at school and at home
   In simple words: practise until you can practise Food and fitness Nutrition at school and at home. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

3. Give Kenyan examples connected to Food and fitness Nutrition
   In simple words: practise until you can give Kenyan examples connected to Food and fitness Nutrition. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: Talk about Food and fitness Nutrition using something you see at school in Kenya.

Example 2: Give a home example from your county, estate, or village.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Underline two new ideas about Food and fitness Nutrition in the examples.
2. Explain Food and fitness Nutrition to a parent using one local example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Food and fitness Nutrition.
4. Practise one skill from this lesson with a friend.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Food and fitness Nutrition using examples from school or home.
2. Answer: Why is Food and fitness Nutrition important for a Grade 3 learner?
3. Make a one-minute oral presentation to a parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION 7: CLASS ACTIVITY IDEAS

1. Discuss the importance groups in all our of eating foods from all the three food groups meals? in a meal
2. Learners can take pictures using computing devices of foods from the different classes and display in class
3. Learners can play games using computing devices on classifying foods into the three food groups

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. Why do we eat food?
2. Which foods protects b) group foods into energy foods using pictures, realia, charts and video our bodies?
3. Which foods build our protective foods,  In groups, learners are guided to identify bodies?

SECTION: REMEMBER

2. Practise Food and fitness Nutrition at school and at home
3. Give Kenyan examples connected to Food and fitness Nutrition
